svg.title: Phase 4 coupon issue flow
svg.desc: The issue API checks Redis, reserves inventory, waits for one replica, then waits for Kafka ACK before returning 202. Kafka Consumer later commits the issued coupon to MySQL.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Noto Sans KR', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Noto Sans KR', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Noto Sans KR', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

svg.text: 앞단에서 거절한 요청은 Kafka로 보내지 않습니다. ACK 뒤에도 DB 저장은 별도로 진행됩니다.
